h1: Sheng Ji for Children and Education: Outcomes, Privacy and Safety
heroSub: No exam or admission guarantee · Protect minors’ data and safety

sections.h2: Education outcomes depend on practical preparation

items.h3: No score, admission or school result is guaranteed
items.content: Sheng Ji is a traditional cultural service. It does not establish improved grades, steadier exam performance, changed admissions decisions or helpful connections.

Teaching, practice, sleep, mental-health support, language skills, application materials and qualified admissions advice have observable roles. A cultural-service purchase should not displace essential education or living costs.

items.h3: Reject urgency based on parental anxiety
items.content: Pause if anyone says a child will lose a once-only window or suffer lifelong consequences without immediate payment. There is no verified starting age or fixed benefit period.

items.h3: Protect the child’s wishes and privacy
items.content: Explain the service and cost and minimise collection of names, birth data, images, school details and grades.

items.h3: Do not instruct a minor to collect a biological sample
items.content: This site does not provide blood self-collection instructions. Ask for a non-invasive alternative and confirm safety, transport, privacy and disposal requirements.

items.h3: Do not act secretly for another person
items.content: Do not collect or send a child’s or adult family member’s personal items or data without informed consent.
Published prices are RMB 72,000 for five years and RMB 500,000 for lifetime, with a RMB 10,000 booking deposit. Consider the opportunity cost and obtain a written quotation.
Verify the practitioner, site, date, materials, records, return items, refund or rescheduling terms and after-service contact.
Translate abstract goals into study plans, application milestones, psychological support and family communication, then review actual progress.

mainEntity.name: Can Sheng Ji guarantee exam or admission results?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This site does not guarantee scores, admission, school placement, overseas-study applications or future career results.

mainEntity.name: What information should a minor provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minimise personal data and obtain a written list before paying. This site does not instruct minors to collect blood or other biological samples.
Prioritise learning, sleep, mental-health and qualified education support, and consider the opportunity cost of the RMB fee.
